general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.一、和定积最大：a + b = 20: 1. Fixed sum, maximum product: a + b = 20
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.取等条件：a = b = 10，此时积取最大值 100。该和下两数恰好都能取整数: Equality condition: a = b = 10, where the product reaches its maximum of 100. Both numbers happen to be integers for this sum, so the positive integer solution also reaches the equality point.
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.二、积定和最小：a × b = 36: 2. Fixed product, minimum sum: a × b = 36
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.取等条件：a = b = √P = 6，此时和取最小值 12。√P 为整数，正整: Equality condition: a = b = √P = 6, where the sum reaches its minimum of 12. √P is an integer, so the positive integer solution also reaches the equality point.
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.已达到最小和: The minimum sum has been reached
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.两数不等: The two numbers are not equal
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.调整到相等即可取最值: Make them equal to reach the extremum
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.判定依据：a、b 越接近，和定时积越大、积定时和越小；只有当 a = b 时两个: Basis: the closer a and b are, the larger the product for a fixed sum and the smaller the sum for a fixed product; both inequalities are equalities only when a = b.
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.高亮行即最大积组合；可见积随两数靠近而单调增大，到 ⌊S/2⌋ 处达到峰值。: The highlighted row is the maximum-product combination; the product grows monotonically as the two numbers get closer and peaks at ⌊S/2⌋.
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.高亮行即最小和组合；因数对越接近 √P，两数之和越小。: The highlighted row is the minimum-sum combination; the closer the factor pair is to √P, the smaller the sum.
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.积定和最小（ab = P）: Minimum sum with fixed product (ab = P)
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.和定积最大（a + b = S）: Maximum product with fixed sum (a + b = S)
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.平方和的最小值: Minimum of the sum of squares
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.已知和求平方和最小值: Minimum sum of squares given the sum
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.已知和求倒数和最小值: Minimum sum of reciprocals given the sum
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.已知平方和求两数之和最大值: Maximum sum of two numbers given the sum of squares
general/liangshuzhihe-chengjizuida-zuixi.六个不等式本质是同一个结论（两数越接近，积越大 / 和越小）的不同写法，区别只在: The six inequalities are essentially the same conclusion (the closer the two numbers are, the larger the product and the smaller the sum) written in different ways; they differ only in whether the constraint is the sum, the product, the sum of squares or the sum of reciprocals.
